dedupe_keys.name: ebu tech 3391 guidelines for dab network planning 2018

description: EBU Tech 3391, dated May 2018, gives guidelines for planning DAB networks. Its contents run from the DAB standards and the difference between DAB and DAB+, through system properties (modulation and guard interval, carrier structure, frequency and time interleaving, single frequency networks, multipath capability, transmission modes, receiver time synchronisation, protection levels, coding and net bit rates, and carrier-to-noise values including new measurements) to planning criteria and parameters such as fixed roof-top, mobile, portable and handheld reception modes. Producer: the EBU, Geneva; the document is 151 pages. Coverage: guidance applicable to DAB networks worldwide. Access: a free PDF on the EBU technical website. Licence and cost: no licence text read; free. Caveats: only the cover and contents were read, so figures such as field strength values were not checked. Simulation uses: the C/N values, reception modes and planning criteria give parameters for coverage and capacity-planning models of digital radio. Related records: EBU TR 024 on SFN planning (data-ebu-tr-024-sfn-planning-t-dab-dvb-t) and EBU TR 051 on DAB coverage measurements (data-ebu-tr-051-dab-coverage-measuring-techniques).
